scope: Record tags, risk snapshots and IP flags only; not the complete decision schema or deployment approval

columns.name: tag
columns.rule: Exact full text; duplicates with distinct row IDs remain allowed

tables.integrity: No source FK/check/secondary uniqueness. Target NUL checks preserve the PostgreSQL text domain; digest columns are database-generated and never unique.

columns.name: risk_level

columns.name: created_at
columns.rule: UTC microseconds; profile out-of-range timestamps before transfer

tables.integrity: No source FK/check/secondary uniqueness. Both readers explicitly choose created_at DESC,id DESC; the previous PostgreSQL equal-time result was undefined.

columns.rule: Exact scoped tenant predicate; no source tenant FK

columns.name: ip_address
columns.rule: Source is TEXT, NOT INET; do not canonicalize IPv4/IPv6 spellings or use INET codecs

columns.name: flag
columns.rule: Full exact text, no case folding/trailing-space equivalence; duplicates remain allowed

columns.name: created_at
columns.rule: UTC, microsecond and MySQL range validation

tables.integrity: No source FK/check/secondary uniqueness. Non-unique accelerators cannot replace full text equality or tenant scope.

grant_contract: These append/read repositories require SELECT and INSERT only on the three owner tables. No runtime UPDATE, DELETE, DDL, ledger access or cross-owner access. Deployment identities/actor authorization still require integration.
resource_contract: Explicit row and aggregate-text-byte budgets; server suppresses oversized projections and readers fail with ErrProjectionLimit, returning no partial list. These budgets are not new column-length restrictions or a throughput claim.
